Center the suspended lower board over the two supports, then lower evenly while keeping both end grasps closed.

Both supports follow the lift. Raise them above the lower board, straighten their yaw, and begin carrying inward to the middle-layer positions.
Center the two middle supports symmetrically on the lower board, then lower toward it while preserving upright orientation.

Continue the final slow descent of the middle board and pause at the estimated support height before opening.
